name: Mollie

webhook.algorithm: TWO SCHEMES — the generator must pick one. Classic webhooks: POST application/x-www-form-urlencoded containing ONLY `id=tr_xxx`, NO signature, NO timestamp; the only correct handling is to re-fetch GET /v2/payments/{id}. Next-gen webhooks: header `X-Mollie-Signature` with value `sha256=<hex>`, HMAC-SHA256 over the unaltered raw body, keyed by the subscription signing secret. NO timestamp is signed, so there is no tolerance window — replay defense must be event-id dedup. Secret rotation via 'Roll secret' (old key valid ~1 day). Verified.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: API keys prefixed `live_` and `test_`; OAuth access tokens prefixed `access_`. Verified in Mollie support/auth docs. In 2026 API keys and Organization Access Tokens were unified under one 'API access tokens' page.

fees.notes: UK pricing page, verified: UK domestic consumer cards 1.20% + £0.20; UK commercial + European cards 2.90% + £0.20; iDEAL £0.30 fixed; Bancontact 1.40% + £0.20; SEPA Direct Debit £0.30 fixed; Klarna 4.99% + £0.30; PayPal = PayPal's fee + £0.10. No monthly fee, pay-as-you-go. EUR-market pricing differs (iDEAL commonly €0.29) — not verified this pass.

notes: The default EU SMB gateway and the single highest-leverage add in this cluster: one integration covers ~20 local European methods (iDEAL, Bancontact, BLIK, P24, EPS, Multibanco, Bizum, Satispay, Swish, Vipps) that Stripe either lacks or prices worse. Self-serve onboarding for sole traders in most EU countries, which Adyen and Checkout.com refuse.

SDKs: Official SDKs: node (@mollie/api-client), python (mollie-api-python), php (mollie/mollie-api-php), plus official Go and Java SDKs. SDKs ship built-in signature validation helpers for next-gen webhooks.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps stripe on card/Apple Pay/Google Pay/Klarna/SEPA but wins on iDEAL, Bancontact, BLIK, Multibanco, Satispay, Swish, Vipps and on EU sole-trader onboarding.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
